title: Sharpened Arcane Needle
text: Upgrade the preceding weapon at the Advanced Assembly Table. Damage, enchantments, custom names and the inserted spell crystal are preserved.
Upgrade 1: 10 damage, 1.9 attack speed, 15 total healing and 125% base special range. Paradox motes increase with level.
